page.overview:
What is Yundu?

Yundu is a fictional extra-dimensional world created by games designer Phil Frances for Chaosium's Call of Cthulhu gaming supplement H. P. Lovecraft's Dreamlands (1986).

Located somewhere in the depths of space in the plane of existence dubbed the Dreamlands, Yundu is the home planet of the bizarre flying creatures known as Wenelians and, possibly, their flying steeds the Phosphorescent Monsters.

Category:Extra-Dimensional Locations Category:Locations Originating From Expanded Mythos Works Category:Planets
